contributions.summary: Round37-aware tools/apply_lane_changes.py --with-cpi-7 --with-fee-8 (items already in Round37 are skipped; Round37's own idls/pump_fees.json and pump_fees client are kept): const-generic legacy buy, SetMayhemVirtualParams layout and handler, declare_program!(pump_amm) generated CPI clients (migrate_v2 keeps its hand-built CPIs to stay within the 4 KiB SBF frame), collect_coin_creator_fee client built inside `if !frozen`. That lane reports the 44-suite corpus passing for the equivalent Round36 H7 candidate. Plus migrate_v2::required_quote_account_len rewritten as an #[inline(never)] TLV walk with a u64 seen-bitset (+0x17c0f0); duplicate TLV entries are skipped exactly as the original does, and the lane reports the migrate_v2 suite at 827/827.

CollectCreatorFeeV2: exported creator-fee collector taking system_program as &AccountInfo (no argument promotion) and emitting the event by reference. That lane independently reproduced the nearmiss changes below (its p02-p04).
